gaps.description: No shared ARN object model for heterogeneous non-causal relation classes, layers, temporal activation, high-order relations and residue.
No representation of perturbation, integration response, rejection, local reconfiguration, oscillation, cascade or delayed transfer.
No EmbeddingEvidenceRecord separates external availability, retrieval, relational linkage, judgment change, action change, transfer and delayed stability.
No deterministic projector, time-respecting path check, higher-order protection, network diff or ARN validator.
No single validator catches adjacency/similarity/centrality/community as truth/value/causality or retrieval/diffusion as integration.

claim_ceiling: This gap ledger establishes a representation gap only; it does not prove that cognition, projects or society are literally networks.
